evidence.quote: David Ridland Michael Crawford Michael Crawford Portfolio Manager David has almost thirty years  experience of investing in both UK and international equities. During his early years as a fund manager, David developed his investment philosophy – focusing on owning high-quality businesses for the long term. He attributes this to Warren Buffett's partner, Charlie Munger, who steered Buffett away from 'cigar-butt' investing to focus on great companies at reasonable prices.  David co-founded Castlebay regarding this as an excellent opportunity to put his quality-value approach into practice.  With the YFS Chawton Global Equity Income Fund now managed by Castlebay advised by Chawton Global Investors, David assists with investment research and portfolio management analysis at Chawton Global Investors.
